title: Can R\'enyi Accountants Beat Lossless Accountants for DP-SGD?
abstract: arXiv:2610.17120v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent frameworks in differential privacy (DP), such as privacy loss distributions and $f$-DP, provide lossless representations of the privacy leakage of mechanisms. These approaches are often considered to yield tighter $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-DP guarantees than those obtained from relaxed notions such as R\'enyi DP. But is that always the case? We study this question for differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) with fixed-size batches under replace adjacency. Our key observation is that in this setting, privacy accounting based on R\'enyi DP can use a pair of worst-case distributions (i.e., a dominating pair) that differs from the one used in the lossless frameworks. In particular, we characterize the worst-case distributions as two-dimensional Gaussian mixtures and derive an improved R\'enyi DP bound for DP-SGD. tldr: 该论文证明，在替换邻接、固定批次大小的DP-SGD设置下，通过将最坏情形分布刻画为二维高斯混合，基于Rényi DP的隐私会计可以获得比无损隐私框架更紧的隐私保证。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that, for DP-SGD with fixed-size batches under replace adjacency, Rényi DP accounting based on a two-dimensional Gaussian-mixture dominating pair can yield tighter privacy guarantees than lossless accounting frameworks.
